verdict.rationale: Dots is operated primarily through natural-language conversation: you talk to it in ChatGPT, Slack, Teams, or a voice call (dots-docs-1, dots-docs-4, dots-docs-5, dots-docs-7). The docs show plain-language requests driving scheduled tasks, bug investigation, and routing preferences (dots-docs-14, dots-docs-15, dots-docs-6), and even control rules are set by describing the action in words (dots-docs-20). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work as documented.
